findings.description: Cache-safe filter seam underspecified: OpenAiModelsManager::list_models builds the catalog in upstream models-manager/src/manager.rs:82-133; copilot.rs::models_manager only selects which SharedModelsManager to return. A filter in CopilotModelsEndpoint alone won't affect try_list_models / cached/offline reads, and the StaticModelsManager (config_model_catalog) branch is unfiltered. Must wrap the FINAL SharedModelsManager (both branches) covering list_models, try_list_models, raw_model_catalog, get_remote_models, try_get_remote_models, and get_model_info.
findings.resolution: Pinned the seam to a fork-local GatedModelsManager decorator in model-provider that wraps the SharedModelsManager returned by copilot.rs::models_manager() in BOTH the OpenAiModelsManager and StaticModelsManager branches, filtering wire_route==ChatCompletions rows from all read methods when off; updated AC #4/#5 + Files + Risk Areas.

findings.description: AC #7 'GPT-5.x /responses byte-unchanged' is not directly verifiable as a whole-path byte invariant. Tighten to concrete evidence: same filter admission, wire_route==ProviderDefault, effective_wire_api(ProviderDefault, Responses)==Responses in both states, and identical serialized /responses request body in an existing request-construction test.
findings.resolution: Reworded AC #7 to concrete semantic-equality assertions (admission + wire_route + effective_wire_api + optional serialized-body equality); dropped the literal 'byte-unchanged' framing.

findings.description: AC #8 instructs running 'cargo test -p ...' directly, violating external/repos/codex-patched/AGENTS.md ('Do not run cargo test directly. Use just test') and missing the 'just fix -p <project>' finalize step.
findings.resolution: Replaced cargo test with 'just test -p <crate>' and added 'just fix -p <crate>' for touched crates; kept 'cargo check --workspace' as the typecheck gate per codex CLAUDE.md.

findings.description: If the launcher unconditionally writes CODEX_ENABLE_ANTHROPIC=off when enable_anthropic is unset (literal style_user_messages mirror), it overrides a caller's ad-hoc CODEX_ENABLE_ANTHROPIC=on, contradicting the 'flag OR env var' mechanism. Define precedence.
findings.resolution: Specified precedence: an explicit launcher enable_anthropic=true/false sets/overrides the env var; when the config field is UNSET the launcher leaves any caller-provided CODEX_ENABLE_ANTHROPIC intact (does not write off). Added AC + launcher modify note + test.

findings.description: AC #6 inherited-Claude test says the child 'does NOT reach the chat transport' but only specifies route fallback. Make verification concrete: assert no /chat/completions request is issued and/or the child's ChatCompletions-hint ModelInfo resolves via effective_wire_api(..., anthropic_enabled=false) to Responses.
findings.resolution: Made AC #6 concrete: assert the child's ChatCompletions-hint ModelInfo resolves through effective_wire_api(..., off) to Responses and that no /chat/completions request is issued (stream dispatch never enters the chat arm).
